title: Vivace Olive Oil Chicken Fettuccine
description: A light and flavorful Italian-inspired pasta dish with chicken and vivace olive oil. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook fettuccine pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of vivace olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Add garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add cooked fettuccine pasta to the skillet and toss with chicken and garlic.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, topped with grated Parmesan cheese and a drizzle of vivace olive oil.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately.
